note: Admin integration suites that are RED on clean main and are therefore excluded from the Integration suites workflow. src/__tests__/integration/admin held 51 suites that one workflow reached by naming one file (production-readiness-gate.yml). Running the directory for the first time found 12 red and 24 failing assertions; backlog item T-032 triaged all 24 and repaired 22. Default is INCLUDED: a new suite in this directory runs unless it is added here, which is what makes the workflow cover work that has not been written yet. Removing an entry is the fix; adding one needs a reason and an owner.
howToClear: Neither of these is a stale contract, and neither can be cleared by rewriting the suite. Each one found something real in shipping code that needs a product decision that an agent must not make. Clearing an entry means the owning backlog item was decided and the code or the scope changed accordingly — then delete the entry here, re-run the directory, and confirm the workflow stays green. Do NOT clear an entry by widening the allow-list the suite checks against; that is the version of this where the lock stops meaning anything.
reasonShape: Every entry names the ONE case that fails and the item that owns the decision. check-admin-integration-quarantine.mjs re-runs each quarantined suite and fails if it PASSES — so an exclusion whose reason has been fixed cannot sit here quietly. That is the control the list would otherwise lack: a name in a file that nobody re-measures is how a carve-out becomes permanent.

quarantined.failingCase: All hex literals in admin tree are canonical > every hex literal is in the allowed set
quarantined.reason: 643 non-canonical hex literals in the admin tree. Measured independently of the suite: 254 distinct literals over 839 occurrences across 229 files, of which 9 are design-token values. This is real drift from the locked palette, not a test defect. The other two failures in this suite WERE test defects and were repaired rather than excluded: a route marker that had gone with retired markup, and a font-family extractor that read the fragment before a stack's first inner quote.

quarantined.failingCase: Admin visible vocabulary > uses Admin vocabulary for page metadata and visible page chrome
quarantined.reason: Two merged decisions contradict each other. docs/releases/records/2026-06-02-admin-metadata-vocabulary.md is an approved record that admin chrome says Admin rather than Setup, and this suite landed with it to enforce that. Twelve days later fb561b85e made Setup the canonical admin experience and set /admin's browser title to match. Two offenders today: that title, and one eyebrow under admin/setup/cxo-intel. Choosing which record wins is a product vocabulary call.
